svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;

<mxfile host="Electron" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="0rRWCg-IwzPsCC5WnJIU"> <mxGraphModel dx="1680" dy="1509" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "flowchart TD
 %% Стилизация по ролям устройств (стандартная цветовая дифференциация)
 classDef cloud fill:#f1f5f9,stroke:#64748b,stroke-width:2px,color:#0f172a
 classDef router fill:#dbeafe,stroke:#2563eb,stroke-width:2px,color:#1e3a8a
 classDef firewall fill:#fee2e2,stroke:#dc2626,stroke-width:2px,color:#7f1d1d
 classDef switch fill:#ccfbf1,stroke:#0d9488,stroke-width:2px,color:#115e59
 classDef server fill:#e0e7ff,stroke:#4f46e5,stroke-width:2px,color:#1e1b4b
 classDef host fill:#dcfce7,stroke:#16a34a,stroke-width:2px,color:#14532d
 classDef attacker fill:#fef3c7,stroke:#d97706,stroke-width:2px,color:#78350f

 %% --- WAN / ISP LAYER ---
 subgraph WAN[\"WAN / ISP Simulation\"]
 NET((\"Net<br/>WAN Cloud\")):::cloud
 ISP_HQ[\"CS-ISP-HQ<br/>Cisco Router\"]:::router
 ISP_BR1[\"CS-ISP-BR1<br/>Cisco Router\"]:::router
 KALI[\"Kali-Linux<br/>External / Pentest Host\"]:::attacker

 NET ---|\"Gi0/1\"| ISP_HQ
 NET ---|\"Gi0/1\"| ISP_BR1
 ISP_HQ ---|\"Gi0/3 ↔ e0\"| KALI
 end

 %% --- HQ SITE ---
 subgraph HQ[\"HQ Site (Headquarters)\"]
 CP_GW_HQ[\"CP-GW-HQ<br/>Check Point Security Gateway\"]:::firewall
 SW_HQ[\"Switch<br/>Core / Distribution L2-L3\"]:::switch

 subgraph HQ_DMZ[\"DMZ Segment\"]
 WEB[\"WEB-Server\"]:::server
 MAIL[\"Mail-Server\"]:::server
 end

 subgraph HQ_MGMT[\"Management & Infra\"]
 CP_SMS[\"CP-SMS-HQ<br/>Security Management\"]:::firewall
 JUMP[\"Jumhost<br/>Admin Jump Host\"]:::server
 DC[\"DC<br/>Domain Controller\"]:::server
 end

 subgraph HQ_LAN[\"Internal User LAN\"]
 LIN_HQ1[\"Linux-HQ_1\"]:::host
 LIN_HQ2[\"Linux-HQ_2\"]:::host
 end

 %% Сегментированные интерфейсы HQ Firewall -> Switch
 CP_GW_HQ ---|\"eth2 ↔ Gi0/0\"| SW_HQ
 CP_GW_HQ ---|\"eth3 ↔ Gi0/1\"| SW_HQ
 CP_GW_HQ ---|\"eth4 ↔ Gi0/2\"| SW_HQ
 CP_GW_HQ ---|\"eth5 ↔ Gi0/3\"| SW_HQ

 %% Подключения к коммутатору HQ
 SW_HQ ---|\"Gi2/2 ↔ e0\"| WEB
 SW_HQ ---|\"Gi2/1 ↔ e0\"| MAIL
 SW_HQ ---|\"Gi1/0 ↔ eth0\"| CP_SMS
 SW_HQ ---|\"Gi1/1 ↔ e0\"| JUMP
 SW_HQ ---|\"Gi1/2 ↔ e0\"| DC
 SW_HQ ---|\"Gi2/0 ↔ e0\"| LIN_HQ1
 SW_HQ ---|\"Gi1/3 ↔ e0\"| LIN_HQ2
 end

 %% --- BRANCH 1 SITE ---
 subgraph BR1[\"Branch 1 (BR1)\"]
 CP_GW_BR1[\"CP-GW-BR1<br/>Check Point Security Gateway\"]:::firewall
 LIN_BR1[\"Linux-BR1<br/>Branch Endpoint\"]:::host

 CP_GW_BR1 ---|\"eth1 ↔ e0\"| LIN_BR1
 end

 %% --- UPLINKS & OVERLAY ---
 ISP_HQ ---|\"Gi0/0 ↔ eth0 (ISP1)\"| CP_GW_HQ
 ISP_HQ ---|\"Gi0/2 ↔ eth1 (ISP2)\"| CP_GW_HQ
 ISP_BR1 ---|\"Gi0/0 ↔ eth0\"| CP_GW_BR1

 %% Логический IPsec VTI туннель
 CP_GW_HQ -.-|\"Route-Based IPsec VTI Tunnel\"| CP_GW_BR1",
 "config": null
